title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
We are seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to design, train, and deploy production ML models. In this role, you will collaborate with data scientists and backend engineers to build scalable intelligence pipelines.

Key Responsibilities:
- Develop predictive models, classification systems, and NLP pipelines using Python, PyTorch, and Scikit-Learn.
- Clean, preprocess, and analyze complex unstructured datasets using Pandas and NumPy.
- Build and maintain inference microservices using FastAPI, Flask, or Docker.
- Experiment with transformer models, LLMs, and prompt engineering / RAG architectures.
- Implement unit testing and continuous integration (CI/CD) for model deployment on Google Cloud (GCP) or AWS.

Requirements:
- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or related STEM field.
- Proficiency in Python, SQL, and modern machine learning libraries (Scikit-Learn, PyTorch, or TensorFlow).
- Hands-on experience with Git, Docker, and REST APIs.
- Strong problem solving, analytical thinking, and team collaboration skills.

title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Full-Stack Software Engineer to build resilient web applications and microservices for our core platform.

Responsibilities:
- Design responsive, accessible user interfaces using React, TypeScript, and modern CSS/Tailwind.
- Architect robust backend services and REST APIs utilizing Node.js, Express, or Python (Flask/Django).
- Design relational schemas and query optimizations with PostgreSQL or MySQL, using Redis for caching.
- Write reliable unit tests (Jest, Pytest) and participate in code reviews.
- Deploy containerized services with Docker and manage deployment workflows using GitHub Actions on AWS.

Requirements:
- B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
- Demonstrated proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Node.js, and SQL.
- Experience with Git, Docker, and agile sprint workflows.
- Good communication skills and a passion for clean, maintainable architecture.

title: Data Analyst & Analytics Engineer
description:
We are hiring a Data Analyst to translate raw operational data into actionable business intelligence.

Key Responsibilities:
- Write complex SQL queries, window functions, and aggregations across PostgreSQL and BigQuery data warehouses.
- Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA) using Python (Pandas, NumPy) to discover trends and anomalies.
- Design executive dashboards in Tableau or Power BI with clear statistical visualizations.
- Collaborate cross-functionally with product and engineering teams to define core KPIs.
- Automate recurring reporting pipelines using Python and scheduled jobs.

Requirements:
- Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, or Economics.
- Strong expertise in SQL and Python for data manipulation.
- Experience with data visualization tools (Matplotlib, Seaborn, Tableau, or Power BI).
- Rigorous attention to detail and strong written/verbal communication.

title: Cloud & DevOps Engineer
description:
Join our infrastructure engineering team to maintain reliable cloud environments and automated CI/CD pipelines.

Responsibilities:
- Manage and monitor containerized workloads using Docker and Kubernetes.
- Build and maintain continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) pipelines using GitHub Actions.
- Provision infrastructure as code using Terraform on AWS or Google Cloud (GCP).
- Maintain Linux servers, Nginx reverse proxies, and system security configurations.
- Monitor system health, latency, and log aggregation using Prometheus or CloudWatch.

Requirements:
- Hands-on experience with Linux administration, Bash scripting, and Git.
- Working knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and Cloud platforms (AWS or GCP).
- Familiarity with Python or Go for infrastructure automation.
- Excellent troubleshooting and problem solving capabilities under incident scenarios.
